_comment: Committed reproducibility pin for the Stage-1 training corpus.
PINNED. The revision, byte sizes and SHA-256 values below were obtained by the
researcher outside this repository and recorded here verbatim. See
The corpus preparation path verifies ALL THREE at run time: filename, exact
byte size and exact sha256. Any mismatch fails closed. A moving `main` is
never used: the scientific runner resolves this exact revision only.
shard_labels_are_a_split is FALSE and load-bearing. The upstream UVW
train/validation/test names are SOURCE SHARDS of one unlabeled Wikipedia
corpus; the shard named test.parquet has no relation to UIT-VSFC official
TEST, which remains SEALED. UNMARK builds its own document-level partition.
concatenation_order is part of the pin: it fixes document enumeration, and
sample_id keys the corruption draw, so a different order is a different
corruption stream at an identical revision.
Changing dataset, revision, any filename, size or sha256 is an EXPERIMENT
DEPENDENCY CHANGE and must be recorded in docs/spec/decisions.md.
Parquet bytes are NOT committed to git.
